messages:
Miriam: Hey team — trying to lock a 60m slot for a cross-team design sync to review API changes, SDK ergonomics, and Console UX flows for the streaming responses feature. Proposed agenda and preflight checklist below.

Ajay: +1. Need to ensure we have API spec, SDK examples, and console mockups in the pre-read.

Miriam: Agenda (high level):
- Quick status (5m)
- API contract & backward-compat (20m)
- SDK ergonomics and snippets (15m)
- Console UX: onboarding & error states (15m)
- Action items & owners (5m)

Devon: Preflight checklist:
1) RFC doc link: https://redwood.infra/rfcs/2026-streaming-resp
2) API OpenAPI snippet (add to RFC):
```yaml
paths:
  /v1/stream:
    post:
      summary: streaming endpoint
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema: {}
```
3) SDK PR: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/421 (includes usage example)
4) Console mockups: Figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz
5) Test prompts + evals: gdrive link (internal)

Sophia: I'm the dev lead; I'll cover SDK changes. @Elenor can you confirm console QA availability?

Elenor: I can take QA + error state validation. Need final mockups 24h before meeting.

Ajay: Who's reviewing API contract for backward compat? I can pair with infra.

Miriam: @Ajay and @Devon you two as reviewers. Also need a lightweight compatibility test matrix (Devon can draft).

Calendar-bot: Poll created — choose preferred slots: Tue 10-11am, Wed 4-5pm, Thu 9-10am — https://calendar.poll/abc

Sophia: Wed 4-5pm works for me.

Devon: Thu 9-10 conflicts with deployment window. Prefer Tue.

Miriam: Ok, we'll take the poll; aim to finalize by EOD. Please add comments in the RFC doc instead of long Slack threads.

Ajay: Quick question — do we want to include the dedicated rollout plan in this meeting or spin a follow-up? Suggest follow-up.

Miriam: Follow-up ok. Add 'rollout plan' to action items if needed.

Elenor: I'll upload the final QA checklist to the RFC doc once mockups finalized.

Sophia: Noted — I'll add SDK changelog notes to the PR.

Miriam: Thanks — action owners: @Sophia SDK examples, @Devon compatibility matrix, @Elenor QA checklist, @Ajay infra review. Ping me if you need more time. :thumbsup:

Ajay: ack :+1:

Devon: ack

Elenor: ack

Calendar-bot: Slot confirmed: Tue 10-11am (Tentative) — will post calendar invite after poll close.

Miriam: Closing thread. If anything urgent, DM me.
